title: Meta Login: Let Users Sign In With Facebook | Orchard Core
description:
Visitors often prefer to sign in with an account they already have, instead of choosing another password for your site.

The Meta Login feature of Orchard Core adds a Facebook button to the login page. You enable the feature, save the application ID and the secret key of a Meta app, and Meta handles the sign-in.

In this video:
• What you need from Meta, and how the sign-in works
• Enabling the Meta Login feature
• The Meta app settings: application identifier and secret key
• The Meta login settings: callback path and tokens
• The Facebook button on the login page
• What the site does when Meta returns the visitor
